title: Optimize custom machine learning operations with Metal tensors
description: Unlock powerful machine learning performance with the Metal Tensor API and Metal Performance Primitives (MPP) Tensor Ops library. Discover how to create portable operations that take advantage of Neural Accelerators in Apple M5 and A19 GPUs. Learn to build custom machine learning kernels for your Core AI applications, and find out how to work effectively with quantized data formats and GPU memory optimization.
